Assam Resumes International River Trade with Dhaka After 70 Years

International river trade has resumed between Assam's Dibrugarh and Dhaka, Bangladesh, after a 70-year hiatus. The first international cargo voyage was flagged off from Dibrugarh, marking the resumption of this trade route.
